title: Push Button
text: Connect signals attached to push buttons on hardware board, 1 input, 1 output, {IO logic} sets IO logic indicator; {Hardware board} sets the view selected hardware, {View push buttons location} sets the view push buttons, {Specify push buttons via} sets the push-button source, {Number of push buttons} sets the push-button selection, {PB n} sets the selected push buttons and {Sample time} sets the sampling interval. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Hardware board
params.values: View selected hardware None (default) | Supported Xilinx ® or Intel ® boards | Custom boards

params.name: IO logic
params.values: IO logic indicator None (default) | Active High | Active Low

params.name: Number of push buttons
params.values: Push-button selection 1 (default) | list of integers in the range [1, n]
